That was the lone hit allowed by Rasmussen (1-0), who struck out 10 batters and walked two in eight innings. Right-hander Bryan Baker struck out two batters in a 1-2-3 ninth. Aranda belted a solo homer off Yankees starter Gerrit Cole (0-1) in the third inning as one of the five hits for the Rays, who secured a 1-0 lead in the best-of-five series. Game 2 is Monday in St. Petersburg. Cole permitted one run on five hits in five innings. Brewers 3, Padres 2 William Contreras homered with two outs in the seventh inning for the go-ahead run to lift Milwaukee to a comeback victory over visiting San Diego in the opener of their National League Division Series. Reliever Adrian Morejon (0-1) opened the seventh and retired the first two hitters before Contreras hit a 406-foot homer to center. Jackson Chourio also homered for the Brewers, his fifth career postseason homer to break the franchise record. Brewers ace Jacob Misiorowski needed 88 pitches to get through four innings, allowing two runs on four hits with six strikeouts. Brewers closer Trevor Megill escaped an inherited jam in the eighth and pitched a scoreless ninth to secure the save, catching a break with a deep flyball which ricocheted off the roof and was caught in left by Chourio. The Padres scored their only two runs in the second inning on an RBI single from Luis Campesano and on a fielder's choice to first. Robbie Ray allowed two runs on four hits in his start, which lasted 2 2/3 innings. San Diego stranded the bases loaded in the seventh, when D.L. Hall (1-0) induced a flyout, and left runners on the corners in the eighth. Game 2 is Sunday in Milwaukee. Dodgers 5, Braves 3 Tarik Skubal dominated over six innings, three home runs powered the offense and Los Angeles opened its NLDS with a victory over visiting Atlanta. Teoscar Hernandez, Kyle Tucker and Max Muncy all went deep as the Dodgers started their quest to become the first National League club to win three consecutive championships and the first major league team to do it since the New York Yankees from 1998-2000. Skubal (1-0) gave up one run on two hits in his first postseason start for Los Angeles. Sean Murphy and Ozzie Albies hit home runs for the Braves, who entered off a wild-card round victory over the Philadelphia Phillies. Left-handed opener Dylan Dodd opened the game with three scoreless innings for Atlanta before giving way to Victor Mederos (0-1), who gave up Hernandez's home run and recorded just one out in the fourth inning. Game 2 is Sunday evening in Los Angeles. White Sox 3, Guardians 0 Munetaka Murakami belted a two-run homer off All-Star Parker Messick and five pitchers combined on a three-hitter as Chicago beat host Cleveland in their ALDS opener. Murakami, a 26-year-old rookie from Japan, hammered a 440-foot shot to right field off Messick in the fourth inning. His first postseason homer -- and 36th overall this year -- plated Miguel Vargas. Chicago extended its lead to 3-0 in the seventh when Colson Montgomery doubled just inside third base against Erik Sabrowski, bringing home Kyle Teel. The White Sox have won three consecutive games to begin their postseason. Game 2 of the best-of-five series is Monday afternoon in Cleveland. The White Sox have won eight of the 14 contests between the teams this season, splitting eight games at Progressive Field, the home of the AL Central champion Guardians. --Field Level Media

item.title: Igor Chernyshov's OT goal lifts Sharks past Kings
item.description: Igor Chernyshov scored twice, including the overtime winner, as the San Jose Sharks edged the visiting Los Angeles Kings 5-4 on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Igor Chernyshov scored twice, including the overtime winner, as the San Jose Sharks edged the visiting Los Angeles Kings 5-4 on Saturday night. Chernyshov, who also had an assist in regulation, one-timed a Macklin Celebrini feed under Anton Forsberg's arm for the game-winner with 1:42 remaining in the extra frame. Tyler Toffoli, Kiefer Sherwood and Nolan Allan also scored while Yaroslav Askarov made 31 saves as the Sharks picked up their second overtime win in as many games to open the season. Toffoli added an assist and Celebrini finished with a pair of assists. Adrian Kempe, Quinton Byfield and Artemi Panarin each scored and added an assist, and Erik Haula also scored a goal for the Kings, who have dropped a pair of games to open the season. Brandt Clarke chipped in two assists and Forsberg stopped 20 shots. Chernyshov gave San Jose a 4-2 lead at 4:08 of the third, beating Forsberg with a backhand on a partial break. The Kings pulled to 4-3 at 10:21 as Haula redirected an Erik Gustafsson point shot past Askarov. Panarin tied it 4-4 at 14:59 of the third, one-timing a Byfield pass past Askarov. San Jose scored three goals in the middle frame to erase a 1-0 deficit and open a 3-1 lead. Toffoli tied it 1-1 at 1:48 of the middle frame on a power play, tapping in a cross-crease feed from Ivar Stenberg, who recorded his first career point with the helper. Sherwood gave the Sharks their first lead of the night at 9:52 when he intercepted a cross-ice pass by the Kings and snapped a shot from the slot past Forsberg. San Jose doubled its lead at 12:32 of the second when Allan snapped a shot under Forsberg's glove. The Kings cut the lead to one with 1.3 seconds remaining in the second as Byfield beat Askarov short-side over the shoulder on a power play. Los Angeles opened the scoring at 15:50 on a power play as Kempe one-timed a cross-ice feed from Panarin blocker side past Askarov for his first of the season. --Field Level Media

item.title: Bosnia votes Sunday in election that could affect EU bid
item.description: Voters are casting ballots for the central tripartite presidency and national parliament.
item.dc:creator: Branko Filipovic, Fedja Grulovic
item.content:encoded: Bosnians are voting on Sunday in elections that could affect their country's European Union membership bid and the influence that the United States and Russia seek over the small Balkan nation. Voters are casting ballots for the country's central tripartite presidency and national parliament, alongside regional legislative races in its two federal entities. Some polling stations had to be temporarily closed due to problems with the electronic voting system, Bosnia's Central Election Commission head Jovan Kalaba told reporters in Sarajevo. The commission redesigned ballots and introduced new biometric voter identification and electronic scanners it said were aimed at curbing voting fraud. Voter frustration has grown over an economic slowdown, the slow pace of EU entry talks and a lingering political crisis in which ethnically based dominant parties from the two entities have repeatedly stalled decisions by the weak central government that links them. Bosnia, which has struggled to recover from the bloody 1992-95 war, secured EU candidate status in December 2022 and the green light to open accession negotiations in 2024. Actual talks have not started because domestic political leaders have yet to enact core requirements such as bolstering judicial oversight and passing anti-corruption laws. Preliminary results are expected to be released by the election commission after polls close at 7 p.m. (1700 GMT) on Sunday. MOVING BEYOND DIVISIVE RHETORIC The Bosnian war ended in 1995 with the US-brokered Dayton peace accord, which left the country split along ethnic lines into the Serb-dominated Republika Srpska and the Bosniak-Croat Federation — linked by the central government and tripartite presidency. Many voters in the country of 3.4 million people say they want to move beyond the divisive rhetoric, but the politics appears stuck. The vote pits rival ethnic parties — the Bosniak SDA, Serb SNSD and Croat HDZ BiH — against multi-ethnic opposition coalitions led by the Social Democratic Party. According to tracking platform Poliwave, the SDA holds a narrow national lead with 21.4%, followed by the SDP on 16.7%. In Republika Srpska, SNSD, the party run by secessionist leader Milorad Dodik, who wants close ties with Serbia and Russia [USN:S8N3KH02O TEXT:"and is at odds"] with the government in Sarajevo, is ahead with 34.2%. "We are ... choosing those who can manage certain processes, build society, and make the Republika Srpska peaceful and stable," said Zeljka Cvijanovic, the SNSD candidate who is seeking a second term in the tripartite presidency. If ethnically based parties prevail and continue their bickering within the central government, the body that would eventually officially join the EU, progress on accession is likely to stall further. In the capital, Sarajevo, Ismar Garasljevic, a 51-year-old high school teacher, said: "More than 30 years after the war, the situation is still the same; we are talking about nationalism ... The same faces, the same story, constantly." Kalaba said that voter turnout stood at 11.94% by 11 a.m. (0900 GMT), down from around 15% by the same time during elections in 2022. Major powers have long sought influence over Bosnia. The EU is seeking to expand its membership across the Balkans, including Bosnia, but Russia is slowing it down, maintaining its support of the Republika Srpska. The US has also sought influence and wants to push for a $1.5 billion [USN:L6N40Y0SF TEXT:"pipeline project"] to import US liquefied natural gas, run by a company with links to the Trump administration, but the EU warned that the company selection lacked competitive transparency. Washington has also clashed with Brussels over the role of the international [USN:L6N41N07W TEXT:"High Representative"], who, under provisions of the Dayton accord, enforces the laws.

item.title: Des explosions entendues pendant la visite du chancelier allemand à Kyiv
item.description: Des sirènes d'alerte aérienne et des explosions ont retenti dimanche dans la capitale ukrainienne, Kyiv, alors que le chancelier allemand Friedrich Merz rendait visite au président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky dans le cadre du renouvellement du soutien de l'Allemagne à l'Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Des sirènes d'alerte aérienne et des explosions ont retenti dimanche dans la capitale ukrainienne, Kyiv, alors que le chancelier allemand Friedrich Merz rendait visite au président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky dans le cadre du renouvellement du soutien de l'Allemagne à l'Ukraine. Alors que la Russie intensifie son offensive contre l'Ukraine, Friedrich Merz, accompagné de dirigeants d'entreprises du secteur de la défense dans le cadre de cette visite surprise, a exhorté Moscou à mettre fin à ses attaques croissantes. Le chancelier allemand a annoncé une aide militaire à l'Ukraine d'une valeur d'environ un milliard d'euros et un programme de soutien énergétique. Friedrich Merz et Volodimir Zelensky ont visité le bâtiment gravement endommagé de l'Académie des sciences d'Ukraine, où au moins deux personnes sont mortes la semaine dernière lors d'une frappe de drones. La Russie pilonne actuellement le cœur de Kyiv avec certaines des frappes de drones, l'offensive la plus importante dans la capitale depuis le début de la guerre en 2022. "Je ne peux que le répéter une fois de plus: Monsieur Poutine, mettez fin à cette guerre insensée", a déclaré Friedrich Merz. "Nous sommes prêts à dialoguer, nous sommes prêts à discuter de la fin de cette guerre, mais ces attaques barbares contre la population civile ukrainienne doivent cesser", a-t-il imploré. Dimanche matin, quatre alertes aériennes ont été entendues dans la capitale ukrainienne, accompagnées d'explosions et de détonations des systèmes de défense aérienne. L'une des frappes russes a touché le pont Nord sur le fleuve Dniepr, endommageant sa chaussée, a déclaré le maire de Kyiv, Vitali Klitschko, sur la messagerie Telegram. Il a précisé que cette frappe avait fait deux blessés et provoqué des dégâts sur le réseau d'eau chaude du secteur. Depuis la semaine dernière, la Russie attaque les ponts de Kyiv afin de perturber les liaisons entre les deux rives de la capitale et les voies logistiques entre le centre et l'est de l'Ukraine. Friedrich Merz a souligné que son déplacement à Kyiv "démontrait que nous ne nous laisserons pas intimider". "Pas plus qu'une attaque de drone survenant au moment même de notre visite", a-t-il dénoncé. Selon Volodimir Zelensky, Vladimir Poutine tente d'affaiblir la résistance ukrainienne en intensifiant les frappes aériennes contre Kyiv et d'autres villes. "Ils s'en prennent aux ponts — pensent-ils vraiment que nous ne réagirons pas? Je suis tout simplement stupéfait par cette volonté animale d'envenimer la situation chaque jour", a-t-il déclaré lors d'une conférence de presse, aux côtés du chancelier allemand. Avant cette déclaration, le ministère russe de la Défense a Russie, en réponse à une interview du président ukrainien dans laquelle il s'était engagé à intensifier les attaques contre les raffineries russes, avait assuré que Moscou accroîtrerait ses frappes sur Kyiv et d'autres régions d'Ukraine, notamment les installations militaires, les sites de l'industrie de la défense et les infrastructures. DES RÉFORMES DEMANDÉES PAR L'UE Le chancelier allemand est arrivé à Kyiv accompagné de la ministre de l'Economie, Katherina Reiche, et d'une délégation comprenant des dirigeants de Siemens Energy, Hensoldt, Diehl Defence, Quantum Systems et d'autres entreprises. Friedrich Merz devait également faire pression sur le gouvernement ukrainien pour qu'il progresse sur les réformes demandées par les partenaires de l'UE, notamment dans la lutte contre la corruption. Volodimir Zelensky a déclaré mercredi, après s'être entretenu par téléphone avec Friedrich Merz, que l'Ukraine finaliserait prochainement un accord conclu avec l'Allemagne pour la production de drones, de missiles et des logiciels associés. L'un des principaux axes de développement devrait être la production rapide de drones antiaériens, que la société allemande Quantum, spécialisée dans les technologies de défense, a testés avec succès. Depuis l'été, la Russie utilise quotidiennement des dizaines de drones d'attaque à réaction à grande vitesse pour cibler des infrastructures civiles et militaires. En avril, Quantum et le fabricant ukrainien WIY Drones ont annoncé la création de Quantum WIY Industries, une coentreprise destinée à produire le drone intercepteur Strila et les technologies de défense aérienne associées. L'accord prévoit également le développement et la production conjoints d'armes d'une portée de plus de 1.000 km que l'Ukraine peut utiliser pour lancer des attaques en profondeur à l'intérieur de la Russie.

item.title: Germany's Merz arrives in Kyiv to the sound of sirens and explosions
item.description: The chancellor will release more than a billion dollars in military aid and nearly $400 million energy-sector repairs, German officials said. Ukraine and Germany also will finalize a deal for joint drone production.
item.dc:creator: Andreas Rinke, Felix Hoske
item.content:encoded: The sound of air raid sirens and explosions rang out in Ukraine's capital Kyiv on Sunday as German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visited President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, pledging support for Ukraine and urging Russia to halt its escalating attacks. Merz will announce a package of measures including the release of €1 billion ($1.13 billion) in military aid and €350 million for repairs in the energy sector, German government officials said. A deal for joint production of various kinds of drones is also due to be finalised. The two leaders visited the badly damaged building of Ukraine's [USN:L1N45K0A2 TEXT:"Academy of Sciences"], where at least two people died in a drone strike last week as Russia pounded the heart of Kyiv with some of the most persistent drone strikes since the start of the war in 2022. "I can only repeat it once again from this point: Mr Putin, put an end to this senseless war," Merz said. "We are ready for talks, we are ready to discuss bringing this war to an end, but these barbaric attacks on the civilian population of Ukraine must stop," he added. Four air raid alerts were heard across the capital on Sunday morning, and explosions and air defence systems also sounded across the city. One of the Russian strikes hit the Northern Bridge across the Dnipro River, damaging its roadway, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said on Telegram. He said the strike had injured two people and damaged a hot water supply system in the area. Russia has been [USN:L1N45P00Z TEXT:"attacking"] Kyiv's bridges since last week in an effort to disrupt links between the capital's two banks and logistics routes between central and eastern Ukraine. MERZ SEEKS PROGRESS ON EU-BACKED REFORMS Merz is accompanied on the visit by Economy Minister Katherina Reiche and an economic delegation including executives from Siemens Energy, Hensoldt, Diehl Defence, Quantum Systems and other companies. Merz is also expected to press the Ukrainian government for progress on reforms requested by EU partners, including in the fight against corruption. Zelenskiy said on Wednesday, after speaking to Merz by phone, that Ukraine would soon [USN:L1N44U0N8 TEXT:"finalise a deal"] with Germany for the production of drones, missiles and related software. A key focus of the agreement is expected to be the rapid production of anti-jet drones, which Quantum, a German defence-technology company, has successfully tested. Since the summer, Russia has used dozens of high-speed [USN:L8N4521KI TEXT:"jet attack drones"] daily to target civilian and military infrastructure. In April, Quantum and Ukrainian manufacturer WIY Drones announced the creation of Quantum WIY Industries, a joint venture to produce the Strila interceptor drone and related air-defence technologies. INCREASED COOPERATION ON LONG-RANGE WEAPONS The deal also involves the joint development and production of weapons with a range of more than 1,000 km (600 miles) that Ukraine can use to launch attacks deep inside Russia. Russia's Foreign Ministry [USN:L1N45P03K TEXT:"said"] on Saturday that Moscow would continue to systematically hit targets in Ukraine in what it said were retaliatory strikes for Ukrainian attacks on Russia in recent months. It warned foreign nationals and diplomatic staff against staying in or travelling to Ukraine. Zelenskiy told Reuters on Saturday his country's armed forces would double down on their attacks on oil refineries in Russia in response to Moscow's "new doctrine" of escalating [USN:L1N45P05A TEXT:"attacks on civilian infrastructure"], which he said was aimed at forcing residents of Kyiv and other cities to flee. ($1 = 0.8887 euros)

item.title: テニス＝世界ランク1位シナー、マスターズ上海大会欠場を発表
item.description: ［３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［３日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスの世界ランキング１位、ヤニク・シナー（２５、イタリア）は３日、長引いている膝のけがの影響で、マスターズ上海大会（７日開幕）を欠場すると発表した。

シナーは７月１２日にウィンブルドン選手権決勝でアレクサンダー・ズベレフ（ドイツ）を下して以来、公式戦でプレーしていない。２０２４年のマスターズ上海大会では、決勝でノバク・ジョコビッチ（セルビア）を下し、優勝した。

シナーはインスタグラムのストーリーズに「残念ながら今年はマスターズ上海大会でプレーできない。上海のファンの前でプレーするのは楽しいだけに、来週プレーできないことを申し訳なく思う」とつづり、「来年会えることを楽しみにしています」と締めくくった。

シナーの今年の成績は４４勝３敗。ウィンブルドンで四大大会５回目の優勝を達成した。

今年のマスターズ上海大会にはディフェンディングチャンピオンのバレンティン・バチェロット（モナコ）、同大会４回優勝のジョコビッチ、世界ランク２位のズベレフ、同３位のカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）らが出場する。

item.title: ゴルフ＝ロッテ選手権で山下が6位浮上、ティティクル単独首位
item.description: ［３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［３日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフのロッテ選手権は３日、米ハワイ州エワビーチのホアカレイＣＣ（パー７２）で第３ラウンドを行い、山下美夢有が６位に順位を上げた。

７位でスタートした山下は６バーディー、１ダブルボギー、１ボギーの３アンダー６９でラウンド。通算１２アンダーの２０４とした。同じく７位で出た畑岡奈紗は２アンダー７０で回ったが、通算１１アンダーの９位に後退した。

岩井千怜と笹生優花はともに４アンダーで回り、通算９アンダーの１８位に浮上した。吉田優利と竹田麗央は通算８アンダーの２４位。西郷真央は通算７アンダーの３０位。西村優菜は４２位、櫻井心那は５３位、岩井明愛は６５位となった。

通算１７アンダーに伸ばしたジーノ・ティティクル（タイ）が単独首位。ユン・イナ（韓国）とポリー・マック（ドイツ）が３打差の２位で並んでいる。

item.title: US carrier George H.W. Bush visits Thailand after six-month Middle East deployment
item.description: The US aircraft carrier George H.W. Bush arrived in Thailand's resort island of Phuket on Sunday with about 4,800 personnel aboard for a rest-and-recreation break after six months supporting US operations in the Middle East.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US aircraft carrier George H.W. Bush arrived in Thailand's resort island of Phuket on Sunday with about 4,800 personnel aboard for a rest-and-recreation break after six months supporting US operations in the Middle East. For the last six months, the Nimitz-class aircraft carrier and its strike group supported Operation Epic Fury and the [USN:L8N44N1OO TEXT:"US naval blockade"] in the US Central Command area of responsibility to secure maritime security and stability in the Middle East , according to the US Navy. Phuket is the first port call for the George H.W. Bush Carrier Strike Group since departing Norfolk, Virginia, and Mayport, Florida, in March, the US Navy said in a statement. Sailors will take part in cultural and community activities in Phuket, including sightseeing tours and a U.S.-Thailand soccer match, it said. The carrier anchored offshore, while crew members are expected to come ashore through Phuket Deep Sea Port and spend time on the popular southern resort island from October 4 to 9, local media reported. Some sailors were seen coming ashore by boat. The visit follows a five-day [USN:L6N44U071 TEXT:"port call"] by the US carrier Abraham Lincoln at Laem Chabang in eastern Thailand last month, with about 5,000 sailors and Marines aboard. A local mayor had estimated each US service member from the Lincoln could [USN:L6N44O0H4 TEXT:"spend"] up to 3,000 baht ($89) per day during the visit. Thailand is the United States' only treaty ally in mainland Southeast Asia. ($1 = 33.53 baht)

item.title: Brewers find home-run power, rally past Padres in NLDS opener
item.description: MILWAUKEE -- William Contreras homered with two outs in the seventh inning for the go-ahead run to lift the Milwaukee Brewers to a 3-2 comeback victory over the San Diego Padres in a battle of the bullpens on Saturday night in the opener of their National League Division Series.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: MILWAUKEE -- William Contreras homered with two outs in the seventh inning for the go-ahead run to lift the Milwaukee Brewers to a 3-2 comeback victory over the San Diego Padres in a battle of the bullpens on Saturday night in the opener of their National League Division Series. Reliever Adrian Morejon (0-1) opened the seventh and retired the first two hitters before Contreras sent a 3-2 pitch 406 feet to center. Jackson Chourio had a game-tying two-run homer in the third off Padres starter Robbie Ray to account for Milwaukee's other runs. The Brewers were last in the NL with 154 homers and next-to-last in the majors, only ahead of Toronto's 152. "I feel like we earned it. I really do," Brewers manager Pat Murphy said. "I take nothing away from our guys. We earned it. We weren't perfect. But we swung the bat pretty darn good." Milwaukee earned a first-round bye and home-field advantage throughout the postseason after winning a franchise-record 103 games, while San Diego won 17 of its final 20 regular-season games before sweeping the Chicago Cubs this week in their wild-card series. Game 2 is set for Sunday afternoon in Milwaukee. Brewers ace Jacob Misiorowski, who led the majors with a 1.80 ERA and 252 strikeouts, needed 88 pitches to get through four innings, allowing two runs on four hits with six strikeouts. "To limit him to only four innings tonight was a job well done by our offense," Padres manager Craig Stammen said. "Our offense has been swinging the bats really good, taking great at-bats. They continued that again tonight." Left-hander Ray allowed two runs on four hits in 2 2/3 innings. Chourio brought the Brewers even at 2-all with his fifth career postseason homer, the most in franchise history. Garrett Mitchell opened with a broken-bat single to short and advanced to second base on a groundout. Chourio then lined the first pitch 420 feet to left-center with an exit velocity of 113.3 mph. The Padres loaded the bases with two outs in the seventh, but left-hander DL Hall (1-0) entered and got Jackson Merrill to fly out to left. Down 3-2, San Diego had runners on the corners with two outs in the eighth, but closer Trevor Megill came on and fanned Fernando Tatis Jr. Megill, who had a team-high 30 saves in 33 opportunities, finished with a scoreless ninth for the save. That included a lucky break when a Ty France flyball which may have left the yard for what could have been a go-ahead, two-run homer hit the roof. The ball was caught in fair territory on the left field warning track by Chourio for an out which was upheld after review. "I think the only thing that you could probably figure on the ball that everybody's going to be talking about is that (the late Brewers broadcasting legend Bob Uecker) decided to put his hand on it and swat it down so Chourio could catch it. So thanks, Ueck," Murphy said. After forcing Misiorowski to throw 25 pitches in a scoreless first inning, the Padres scored two runs in a 33-pitch second inning. Xander Bogaerts reached on a one-out infield single and Ethan Salas singled. Luis Campusano followed with an RBI single to right. Salas then scored from third, sliding home ahead of the throw on Jake Cronenworth's fielder's choice bouncer to first. "Anytime you score first in a playoff game you feel really good about it, especially the type of pitching staff we have," Stammen said. "We just got beat by a couple home runs tonight." --Jim Hoehn, Field Level Media

item.title: Estados Unidos aprovecha errores defensivos y golea 3-0 a México
item.description: La selección de fútbol de Estados Unidos aprovechó el sábado los errores defensivos de México para golearlo por 3-0 en el llamado "clásico de la Concacaf".
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La selección de fútbol de Estados Unidos aprovechó el sábado los errores defensivos de México para golearlo por 3-0 en el llamado "clásico de la Concacaf". En el partido disputado en el State Farm Stadium de Glendale, Arizona, Julian Hall, Cavan Sullivan y Malik Tillman anotaron los goles del triunfo para la selección dirigida por el argentino Mauricio Pochettino. "Está claro que han pasado situaciones, pero hay que estar ahí y forzar los errores, y por supuesto que estoy contento. Por supuesto que sabíamos de la rivalidad y de lo que significa, pero lo más importante es ir creciendo para el futuro, el equipo mostró mucha madurez, en los momentos de dificultad mostró un control emocional", dijo Pochettino en conferencia de prensa tras el partido. México inició dominando el partido y tuvo la primera opción de abrir el marcador a los tres minutos cuando Santiago Giménez quedó frente a la portería en el área chica, pero falló al intentar rematar un pase de Roberto Alvarado. A pesar del dominio de México, Estados Unidos se puso en ventaja en su primera llegada a los 28 minutos, cuando Hall definió de derecha en el área chica al aprovechar un error del portero Raúl Rangel, quien dejó el balón suelto al tratar de cortar un centro de Giovanni Reyna. México tuvo la segunda oportunidad de anotar a los 43 minutos, pero Giménez volvió a mandar su remate por un lado a pesar de quedar sin marca en el área chica después de que el portero Diego Kochen rechazó un potente disparo de Luis Romo. Estados Unidos empezó dominando la segunda parte, y México estuvo cerca de empatar a los 58 minutos con un potente disparo de Alvarado dentro del área que desvió Kochen. El segundo gol de Estados Unidos cayó a los 62 minutos gracias a otro error de Rangel, quien al tratar de iniciar una jugada en las afueras del área, dejó el balón en los pies de Sullivan, quien aprovechó el regalo para definir con un colocado zurdazo. La situación para México se complicó a los 67 minutos con la expulsión de Mateo Chávez, quien vio la tarjeta roja por dar una cachetada al centrocampista Sebastian Berhalter cuando el jugador estadounidense le reclamó una falta previa. Estados Unidos siguió controlando el partido y metió el tercer gol a los 84 minutos con un potente zurdazo de Tillman dentro del área después de ganar el balón cuando el centrocampista Álvaro Fidalgo dio un pase retrasado. De esta manera, México sufrió su primera derrota bajo la dirección técnica de Rafael Márquez, quien fue presentado el 10 de septiembre como estratega de la selección tras haber sido asistente técnico de Javier "Vasco" Aguirre en el pasado Mundial. En sus dos primeros compromisos bajo la tutela de Márquez, México empató por 1-1 ante Colombia y Perú. "Han sido errores muy groseros en los que les regalas estos tres goles al rival, es duro perder de esta manera porque fueron regalos nuestros y no aciertos del rival, pero son errores que obviamente se pueden corregir. Creo que hay cosas buenas que rescatar, pero con la preocupación de hacer autocrítica y reponernos lo más rápido posible porque tenemos otro partido en pocos días", dijo Márquez. El próximo partido de México será el 6 de octubre cuando enfrente a Chile en el Memorial Coliseum de Los Ángeles. En tanto, Estados Unidos jugará ante Canadá.

item.title: Martin Necas' 3 points help Avalanche blast Blues
item.description: Martin Necas had two goals and added an assist, Nathan MacKinnon had three assists, and the Colorado Avalanche beat the St. Louis Blues 6-1 in Denver on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Martin Necas had two goals and added an assist, Nathan MacKinnon had three assists, and the Colorado Avalanche beat the St. Louis Blues 6-1 in Denver on Saturday night. Nicolas Roy, Artturi Lehkonen and Josh Manson had a goal and an assist each and Cale Makar also scored for Colorado, which is off to a fast start this season. Mackenzie Blackwood made 25 saves and Parker Kelly had two assists for the Avalanche, who have scored 14 goals in sweeping their season-opening two-game homestand. Dalibor Dvorsky scored for the second straight night for St. Louis, which was playing the second game of a back-to-back after winning 4-0 at Dallas on Friday night. Jordan Binnington turned away 30 shots and had two costly turnovers that led to goals. The first came after Manson's goal made it 3-0 early in the second period. Binnington tried to clear the puck up the center of the ice, Lehkonen knocked it down in the slot and scored into the open net at 11:40. Colorado put it away with two goals late in the second. Roy's one-timer at 18:02 beat Binnington on the short side. The goaltender's second gaffe, when he misplayed the puck behind the net, led to Necas' second of the night 23 seconds later. Binnington has allowed six goals in each of his last two starts against the Avalanche, with the last coming on New Year's Eve 2025 in Denver. Colorado took the early lead when MacKinnon fed Necas in front of the net, he slid the puck to Makar at the right of the crease, and he lifted it over Binnington's pads at 4:09 of the first. Necas made it 2-0 later in the period when Lehkonen stole the puck in the offensive zone, sent it to MacKinnon, and his cross-zone pass found Necas at the left circle. Necas wristed a shot to the far post at 13:12. Dvorsky spoiled Blackwood's shutout bid when he scored at 2:34 of the third period. --Field Level Media

item.title: Panthers, without injured captain Aleksander Barkov, take on Ducks
item.description: The Florida Panthers go into their third game of the new season with injuries creating the biggest headlines, which was the case during the 2025-26 campaign.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Florida Panthers go into their third game of the new season with injuries creating the biggest headlines, which was the case during the 2025-26 campaign. When the Panthers visit the Anaheim Ducks on Sunday night, they will be without center and team captain Aleksander Barkov, who was placed on long-term injured reserve with a lower-body injury on Saturday. He must miss at least 10 games. Barkov left the second period of Florida's 4-3 overtime loss to the host San Jose Sharks on Thursday after going down awkwardly while battling for the puck. He missed the entire 2025-26 season with ACL and MCL injuries to his right knee sustained on the first day of training camp. Barkov was able to play for Finland in the IIHF World Championship, helping the team win the gold medal in May. The injury on Thursday night appeared to be to his left leg. "It's not related to his injury last year at all," Panthers coach Paul Maurice said after Thursday's game. Maurice told reporters on Saturday that Barkov would return to Florida to be examined by the team's medical personnel to determine the exact nature of the latest injury. Barkov, 31, is a three-time winner of the Selke Trophy as the NHL's top defensive forward and was a key part of the Panthers' Stanley Cup-winning teams in 2024 and 2025. Florida began Thursday's game without defenseman Gustav Forsling due to an upper-body injury. Forsling scored in the Panthers' 1-0 overtime win over the host Carolina Hurricanes in the season opener on Tuesday. Brad Marchand (lower body) is expected to miss the entire month of October due to a surgical procedure in August, and winger Jonah Gadjovich is on long-term injured reserve. He has been out since having neck surgery last November. Maurice said Forsling is a game-time decision on Sunday night. Center Sam Lafferty and defenseman Alexander Petrovic were recalled from AHL Charlotte on Saturday. Eetu Luostarinen scored twice in the loss on Thursday and Matthew Tkachuk added a goal. Akira Schmid made 28 saves in his Panthers' debut. The Ducks are coming off their season opener on Friday night, when they held on for a 4-3 win over the host Vegas Golden Knights, who eliminated Anaheim in the second round of the Western Conference playoffs last season. The Ducks led 4-0 after two periods. "First one done, 83 more to go," said goalie Lukas Dostal, who stopped 27 shots. Leo Carlsson had a goal and an assist Friday for the Ducks. Carlsson, 21, signed a five-year, $90 million offer sheet with the Philadelphia Flyers during the offseason, which Anaheim matched. "I think from the day that we drafted him, we viewed him as a cornerstone piece of our rebuild, and that hasn't changed," Ducks general manager Pat Verbeek said. "We feel that Leo at some point, and I wouldn't say next year, but I think over the course of this contract, is going to show the elite player that he is, and it's going to give us great reasons for why we matched this offer." Carlsson had 29 goals and 67 points in 70 games last season and added four goals and 11 points in 12 playoff games. Beckett Sennecke, Alex Killorn and Jeff Malott also scored for the Ducks on Friday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Japan's Takaichi protests to US after Marine accused of murder in Okinawa
item.description: Lance Corporal Devin Jacob Ballard, 20, is suspected of killing Anna Yagi, 39, in a hotel in Naha. Ballard denied the allegations, police said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi registered a protest with the United States on Sunday after a US Marine was arrested on suspicion of robbing and murdering a Japanese woman in Okinawa. Lance Corporal Devin Jacob Ballard, 20, is suspected of killing Anna Yagi, 39, in a hotel in Naha, the capital of the southernmost prefecture, on Saturday and taking her wallet and backpack, police said. Ballard denied the allegations, police said. "The occurrence of such an extremely brutal and vicious incident is extremely regrettable," Takaichi said in a statement. "The government of Japan strongly protests to the US side and strongly seeks maximum cooperation with the investigation," as well as the tightening of discipline and thorough measures to prevent a recurrence, she said. Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi, in comments carried by national broadcaster NHK, said: "Such an incident is unacceptable and I am deeply outraged." The US embassy and the Marine Corps expressed condolences over the incident and said they were cooperating with the Japanese authorities. The Marines said in a statement that the suspect, who is assigned to the III Marine Expeditionary Force and based at Marine Corps Air Station Futenma, was in Japanese custody. "The Marine Corps takes these allegations very seriously and expects every Marine to adhere to the highest standards of behaviour," it said. Most of the 18,000 Japan-based Marines are stationed in Okinawa, which the US held from the end of World War Two until 1972. Their presence has repeatedly stirred resentment among residents over issues such as noise, aircraft crashes and the conduct of personnel. The 1995 rape of a 12-year-old Okinawan girl by three US servicemen sparked mass protests. Saturday's killing could complicate Takaichi's efforts to [USN:L1N455098 TEXT:"relocate some Marines"] from the busy Futenma air base to a more remote facility at Henoko. Opponents want the troops moved out of the prefecture. Okinawa, which is 100 km (60 miles) from Taiwan at the closest point, is viewed by Tokyo and Washington as key in deterring potential military aggression from China.

item.title: Kirill Kaprizov, Wild overcome slow start to blow past Bruins
item.description: Kirill Kaprizov scored a pair of goals, and the Minnesota Wild pulled away for a 4-1 win over the Boston Bruins on Saturday night in Saint Paul, Minn.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Kirill Kaprizov scored a pair of goals, and the Minnesota Wild pulled away for a 4-1 win over the Boston Bruins on Saturday night in Saint Paul, Minn. Quinn Hughes tallied a goal and an assist for Minnesota, which won its second game in a row to start the season. Wild captain Jared Spurgeon also scored a goal. Tanner Jeannot scored the lone goal for Boston, which was playing on short rest after defeating the Winnipeg Jets one night earlier. Wild goaltender Jesper Wallstedt stopped 26 of 27 shots to earn the victory. Bruins goaltender Michael DiPietro allowed three goals on 29 shots in his season debut. DiPietro stuffed Wild forward Matt Boldy on a breakaway but allowed a pair of power-play goals. The Bruins opened the scoring less than two minutes into the game. Jeannot set up toward the left side of the crease, took a short pass from Mark Kastelic and fired the puck into the back of the net for his first goal of the season. Boston held that lead for over a full period before Minnesota pulled even with 13:49 to go in the second period. The Wild capitalized on a power-play opportunity when Maxim Shabanov got the puck behind the net and passed it to Kaprizov, who scored on a snap shot. The Wild delivered on the power play once again to grab a 2-1 lead with 7:32 remaining in the second period. Ryan Hartman won a faceoff and Bobby Brink redirected the puck to Hughes, who skated to the high slot and unleashed a wrist shot through traffic that beat DiPietro. Minnesota made it 3-1 with 16:36 left in the third period. Spurgeon fired a long shot that deflected off the skate of Bruins defender Nikita Zadorov and into the net. Kaprizov capped the scoring when he punched in a backhanded shot for an empty-net goal with 1:01 to go. The play gave him three goals in two games to start the season. -Field Level Media

item.title: テニス＝ルバキナ、世界ランク1位としての初戦で逆転負け
item.description: ［３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［３日　ロイター］ - テニスの中国オープン（ＯＰ）は３日、北京で試合を行い、女子シングルス２回戦で世界ランキング１位のエレーナ・ルバキナ（カザフスタン）が初戦敗退を喫した。

この日が初戦となった第１シードのルバキナは、アリーナ・チャラエワ（アルメニア）と対戦し、第１セットは６─３で奪ったものの、続くセットを４─６、３─６で落として逆転負け。９月の全米ＯＰで優勝し、キャリア初の世界ランク１位となったルバキナだが、トップに浮上した後の最初の試合で敗れた選手としては、大坂なおみに次ぐ史上２人目となった。

ＷＴＡランキングは１９７５年に初めて発表されたが、ＯｐｔａＡｃｅによると、それ以降で世界ランク１位の相手に逆転勝ちを収めた選手では、今回のチャラエワ（１１８位）が最もランクの低いプレーヤーだという。

ルバキナは「間違いなく、今日は非常に厳しい試合だった。全米ＯＰで優勝してからいろいろなことがあった。睡眠や回復の機会をあまり持てなかった。アリーナをお祝いしたい。彼女は素晴らしい試合をした」と話した。

item.title: ＮＢＡ＝ピストンズ、デューレンとの契約延長を正式に発表
item.description: ［３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［３日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のピストンズが３日、制限付きフリーエージェント（ＦＡ）のセンター、ジェイレン・デューレン（２２）との契約延長を正式に発表した。

これまで米スポーツ専門チャンネルＥＳＰＮとジ・アスレチックは５年総額２億ドル（約３１６億円）と報じていたが、チームは契約の詳細を明かしていない。

ピストンズのバスケットボール運営部門代表を務めるトラジャン・ラングドン氏は「今後何年もジェイレンをチームの中心に据えられることをうれしく思う」とし、「彼は若くして多くを成し遂げており、われわれは彼の全盛期はこれからだと信じている」と述べた。

報道によると、ピストンズは最近デューレンに同じ総額２億ドルの契約を提示したものの、体重に関する条項を盛り込んでいたという。今回の合意では同条項が削除されたと報じられている。

昨季初めてオールスターとオールＮＢＡに選出されたデューレンは、レギュラーシーズンで自己最多の１試合平均１９．５得点に加え、１０．５リバウンドを記録。ピストンズは６０勝２２敗で東カンファレンス最高成績を残した。一方、プレーオフでは同１０．２得点、８．５リバウンドに数字を落とし、チームは東カンファレンス準決勝でキャバリアーズに３勝４敗で敗れた。

item.title: First-period goals hold up as Predators fend off Stars
item.description: First-period goals by Steven Stamkos and Nils Hoglander held up to the final buzzer as the host Nashville Predators claimed a 2-1 victory over the Dallas Stars on Saturday for their first win of the season.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: First-period goals by Steven Stamkos and Nils Hoglander held up to the final buzzer as the host Nashville Predators claimed a 2-1 victory over the Dallas Stars on Saturday for their first win of the season. Goaltender Juuse Saros made 29 saves -- 12 in the third period -- for the Predators, who rebounded after opening the campaign with a home loss to the Minnesota Wild on Thursday. Miro Heiskanen scored for the Stars, who have dropped two consecutive games to begin the season. Goalie Casey DeSmith stopped 24 shots and was denied the 100th victory of his career. With his team trailing after an early Dallas goal, Stamkos tied it on the power play when he unloaded a one-timer from the left faceoff dot set up by Ryan O'Reilly for the 625th goal of his career. Stamkos is tied with a pair of Hall of Fame luminaries in Joe Sakic -- one of his boyhood idols -- and Jarome Iginla for 17th on the NHL's all-time goals list. O'Reilly's assist was the 899th point of his career. The Predators carried the momentum and took the lead when Hoglander netted his first of the season by redirecting the point shot for another man-advantage tally at 15:49. Dallas regained its footing and pushed the rest of the way, but Saros held strong. Coming off a season-opening 4-0 loss to the visiting St. Louis Blues on Friday, the Stars were looking for a quick start and received it when Heiskanen opened the scoring 47 seconds into the clash by finishing a scramble. Nashville defenseman William Trudeau, claimed off waivers from the New York Rangers late last month, made his NHL debut. --Field Level Media

item.title: サッカー＝国際親善試合、ブラジルがインドに快勝 リノが初ゴール
item.description: ［コルカタ（インド） ３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［コルカタ（インド）　３日　ロイター］ - サッカーの国際親善試合が３日、各地で行われ、サムエウ・リノが代表初ゴールを決めたブラジルがアウェーでインドに４─０と快勝を収めた。

ブラジルは前半２８分、右サイドから切れ込んだエステバンがネットを揺らして先制し、さらに同４２分にはペドロのゴールもアシスト。後半１３分にリノが代表初得点を挙げると、試合終盤にリノが相手の守備をかわして自身この日２点目を記録した。

世界ランキング１３８位のインドは６戦連続で未勝利に。カルロ・アンチェロッティ監督率いるブラジルはオーストラリア戦も含めた遠征を２勝１分けとした。

item.title: Penguins relinquish 4-goal lead, recover to beat Canadiens in OT
item.description: Tommy Novak scored two goals, including the game-winner at 1:33 of overtime, and also had an assist to give the Pittsburgh Penguins a wild 6-5 victory over the visiting Montreal Canadiens on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Tommy Novak scored two goals, including the game-winner at 1:33 of overtime, and also had an assist to give the Pittsburgh Penguins a wild 6-5 victory over the visiting Montreal Canadiens on Saturday night. Evgeni Malkin, who finished with a goal and two assists, crossed a pass past Montreal defenseman Mike Matheson to Novak at the bottom of the right circle on a 2-on-1 break and Novak roofed a wrist shot over goaltender Jakub Dobes for the game-winner. Erik Karlsson and Kris Letang each had two assists and Ben Kindel, Declan Carlile and Samuel Girard also scored goals for Pittsburgh, which won despite blowing a 5-1 lead. Arturs Silovs made 20 saves. Sidney Crosby had an assist, the 1,109th of his career, moving him into a tie with Joe Thornton for seventh in NHL history. Nick Suzuki had a goal and three assists, Cole Caufield scored two goals, Chris Kreider and Ivan Demidov each had a goal and an assist and Lane Hutson chipped in with three assists for Montreal. Dobes finished with 24 saves. Montreal, which opened the season with a 3-2 victory at Toronto, jumped out to a 1-0 lead at the 3:49 mark of the first period when Caufield snapped a wrist shot from the right circle inside the far left post. Pittsburgh tied it on a power-play goal by Malkin, who chipped in a rebound of a Kris Letang shot for his second goal of the season.. The Penguins then scored four consecutive goals to start the second period to take a 5-1 lead. Carlile started the blitz 32 seconds into the period with a wrist shot from the top of the right circle that beat Dobes on his glove side. Girard followed when he roofed a backhand pass from Crosby from the low slot. Novak then finished a 2-on-1 rush with a wrist shot off an Egor Chinakov cross, and Kindel made it 5-1 with a power-play goal, redirecting a point shot by Karlsson into the top right corner of the net. Suzuki cut the lead to 5-2 just before the end of the period when he split a pair of defenders and fired a shot over Silovs' right shoulder. Caufield got his second goal of the game early in the third period with a wrist shot from the high slot to close the gap to two. The Canadiens then scored twice in the final 68 seconds to earn a point and force overtime, the first by Kreider and the second by Demidov off a Suzuki crossing pass with 44 seconds to go. --Field Level Media

item.title: Argentina golea 7-0 a Burkina Faso en partido amistoso
item.description: La selección de fútbol de Argentina exhibió el sábado su renovado poderío ofensivo, sin la presencia de Lionel Messi, al golear por 7-0 a Burkina Faso en un partido amistoso en el marco de la fecha FIFA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La selección de fútbol de Argentina exhibió el sábado su renovado poderío ofensivo, sin la presencia de Lionel Messi, al golear por 7-0 a Burkina Faso en un partido amistoso en el marco de la fecha FIFA. Los goles del triunfo los anotaron Lautaro Martínez, Gianluca Prestiani, Nicolás Paz, Julián Álvarez, Giovani Simeone, Franco Mastantuono y Moumouni Daillo en contra de su propia valla. Argentina fue muy superior al joven seleccionado africano que arribó a Buenos Aires pocas horas antes del inicio del partido luego de afrontar dificultades logísticas con el viaje, de acuerdo a un comunicado de la organización. La "albiceleste" volverá a jugar el martes ante Benín en el estadio Monumental, en un partido con el que Messi se despedirá de la selección. El astro, que capitaneó a Argentina hacia la victoria en la Copa del Mundo de 2022 y la final de 2026, comunicó un mes atrás su retiro del equipo nacional luego de 19 años, pero sigue su carrera en Inter Miami. "Sabemos que se nos va Leo y ahora empieza todo un camino nuevo con chicos que se suman. Hay un gran grupo que se formó y seguiremos con la misma línea", dijo Enzo Fernández tras la goleada. En el partido disputado en el estadio Monumental, Argentina aprovechó una infracción innecesaria dentro del área para abrir el marcador a los cuatro minutos a través de Lautaro Martínez, al convertir en el rebote de un penal que le tapó el portero Razak Guira. Cuatro minutos después, otro error de Burkina Faso le permitió al conjunto dirigido por Lionel Scaloni ampliar la ventaja gracias a un gol de Moumouni Daillo en contra de su propia puerta tras un remate de Julián Álvarez. Antes del final de la primera parte, la "Albiceleste" anotó otros tres goles por intermedio de Gianluca Prestiani, Nicolás Paz y Julián Álvarez a los 24, 34 y 36 minutos, respectivamente. En el segundo tiempo, Argentina completó la goleada con tantos de Franco Mastantuono y Giuliano Simeone a los minutos 77 y 92. "Estoy muy contento de volverme a poner la camiseta de Argentina. Me quedé afuera del Mundial y fue triste, pero tenía que seguir trabajando para volver y hoy me tocó hacer un gol", dijo Mastantuono.

item.title: Islanders rout Devils in home-opening shutout
item.description: Simon Holmstrom, Brayden Schenn and Bo Horvat scored within a nine-minute span in the second period Saturday night and goalie Ilya Sorokin stopped all 37 shots he faced for the New York Islanders, who won their home opener by routing the New Jersey Devils 6-0.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Simon Holmstrom, Brayden Schenn and Bo Horvat scored within a nine-minute span in the second period Saturday night and goalie Ilya Sorokin stopped all 37 shots he faced for the New York Islanders, who won their home opener by routing the New Jersey Devils 6-0. Victor Eklund, Ondrej Palat and Casey Cizikas scored in the third for the Islanders, who bounced back from a 2-1 season-opening loss at Toronto. Reigning Calder Trophy winner Matthew Schaefer had two assists. The shutout for Sorokin was the franchise-record 30th of his career. Nico Daws made 26 saves for the Devils, who have also split their first two games. The Devils outshot the Islanders 9-7 in a scoreless first before the hosts took control into the second. Adam Pelech set up Holmstrom's goal by weaving through the neutral zone and dishing to Jean-Gabriel Pageau, who drew Daws to the right of the crease before dishing to Holmstrom. The winger then sent a shot over the right leg of the sprawling Daws at 3:32. A Devils turnover led to Schenn's goal just 88 seconds later. Schaefer picked off Stefan Noesen's pass just in front of the blue line and fired a shot that bounced off Daws. Eklund picked up the puck and sent a pass between his and Daws' legs to Schenn, who buried the point-blank chance. Schaefer collected another assist with 7:52 left in the second, when he fed Horvat at the front of the right faceoff circle before the Islanders captain directed a shot beyond Daws' glove. Eklund celebrated his 20th birthday by scoring his first NHL goal with 8:28 left in the third, when he got a stick on Calum Ritchie's pass and tucked a shot over Daws' glove. Palat added another insurance goal just 42 seconds later and Cizikas, in his 16th season with the Islanders, scored a short-handed goal with 1:19 left. --Field Level Media

item.title: Canes rally past Flyers in OT to secure first win of title defense
item.description: Shayne Gostisbehere scored a power-play goal in overtime to lift the Carolina Hurricanes to their first victory of the season with a 3-2 road win over the Philadelphia Flyers on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Shayne Gostisbehere scored a power-play goal in overtime to lift the Carolina Hurricanes to their first victory of the season with a 3-2 road win over the Philadelphia Flyers on Saturday. Gostisbehere's decisive goal was a one-timer from the top of the left circle at 2:51 of the extra session. The former Flyers defenseman benefited from a terrific screen from Andrei Svechnikov, who knocked down Philadelphia's Nick Seeler before impeding Joseph Woll's vision in front of the net. Pyotr Kochetkov made 16 saves to earn the win for Carolina, which had lost its first two contests of the young campaign. The defending champions' first two goals Saturday came courtesy of Sebastian Aho, including one 10 seconds into the contest. Owen Tippett and Matvei Michkov scored for Philadelphia, which was swept by Carolina in the Eastern Conference semifinals last season. Woll turned aside 37 shots for the hosts, who remain winless in three games this season. The game could not have gotten off to a better start for the Hurricanes, who promptly scored off the opening faceoff. William Carrier quickly centered the puck right past Flyers center Christian Dvorak and onto the stick of Aho, who snapped one past Woll. Philadelphia drew even at 8:03 of the first period as Tippett collected a loose puck in the high slot and buried a shot past Kochetkov. Michkov's first of the season gave the Flyers a 2-1 lead at 7:20 of the second period. However, Aho tied it at 2-2 early in the third period, as he scored a power-play goal from a similar spot to his first tally. This one came off a feed from Nikolaj Ehlers, setting up Aho's one-timer. The Flyers went on the power play late in regulation, but they struggled to enter the offensive zone. The man advantage carried over into overtime, when Tyson Foerster and Trevor Zegras had quality scoring chances, although Kochetkov held firm. Shortly thereafter, Carolina received a power play of its own when Tippett was whistled for slashing. With the Hurricanes skating 4-on-3, Svechnikov's one-timer was denied by Woll. However, Gostisbehere buried the game-winner less than a minute later. Philadelphia defenseman Rasmus Ristolainen left with an apparent hand injury. The team said he'll be further evaluated Sunday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Senators break tie in third, edge Leafs in season opener
item.description: Stephen Halliday scored the tiebreaking goal midway through the third period Saturday night and the visiting Ottawa Senators won their season opener, defeating the host Toronto Maple Leafs 3-2.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Stephen Halliday scored the tiebreaking goal midway through the third period Saturday night and the visiting Ottawa Senators won their season opener, defeating the host Toronto Maple Leafs 3-2. Newly appointed captain Thomas Chabot had a goal and assist and Michael Amadio also scored for Ottawa. Claude Giroux added two assists and Linus Ullmark stopped 27 shots. Auston Matthews and Kirill Marchenko scored for the Maple Leafs, who have lost two of their first three games, all at home. Sergei Bobrovsky made 26 saves for the Maple Leafs. The Maple Leafs hit both posts with shots in the first period. Teddy Blueger hit the left post at 13:28 on a redirect. Jack Roslovic hit the right post at 13:58. Ottawa scored the first goal when Chabot jumped up on the rush and knocked in a 12-footer off a rebound at 18:51 of the first period. Toronto tied the game 33 seconds into the second period on a tip-in by Matthews on Morgan Rielly's shot from the point. Marchenko flipped in a backhand shot on a pass from Darren Raddysh at 7:06 of the second on a power play. Giroux was off for slashing. Amadio tied the game at 12:40 of the second on a 2-on-1 counter with Tim Stutzle, who made a deft pass to the edge of the crease. Toronto had just been foiled on a rush. Halliday snapped in a five-footer at 9:46 of the third on a rebound to give Ottawa the lead. Toronto had a power-play chance at 14:20 of the third but did not get a shot on goal. Bobrovsky was pulled for an extra attacker with just under three minutes left in regulation. Matthews hit the post at 18:08. Bobrovsky had to return to the net after the Senators applied pressure. Ottawa defenseman Jake Sanderson did not return after the first period due to an undisclosed injury. --Field Level Media

item.title: Andrei Vasilevskiy sharp as Lightning beat Capitals
item.description: Reigning Vezina Trophy winner Andrei Vasilevskiy stopped 20 shots in his 600th career game, and the Tampa Bay Lightning won for the first time this season by topping the visiting Washington Capitals 3-1 on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Reigning Vezina Trophy winner Andrei Vasilevskiy stopped 20 shots in his 600th career game, and the Tampa Bay Lightning won for the first time this season by topping the visiting Washington Capitals 3-1 on Saturday night. Jake Guentzel had a goal and an assist, and Charle-Edouard D'Astous and Conor Geekie also found the net as Tampa Bay evened its record through two matches. Brandon Hagel had two assists. Justin Sourdif scored for the Capitals, who lost the second part of their weekend back-to-back set. Goaltender Charlie Lindgren made 27 saves for Washington, and teammate Dylan Strome skated in his 600th game. After losing 5-1 at the New York Rangers on Thursday in their season opener, the Lightning needed less than 2 1/2 minutes to strike for their initial home goal. D'Astous sent in a shot near the right circle that beat Lindgren for the defenseman's first tally. While Tampa Bay's power play went 0-for-7 in the opening defeat, it clicked early on the match's first man advantage when Sourdif went off for holding at 8:35. Though it did not find the net, the unit put plenty of pressure on Lindgren and had close chances. As D'Astous did, Geekie ripped a shot that smoked Lindgren high on the left side to increase the lead to two goals at 16:30 as the club dominated by leading 14-5 in shots in the first period. Following a 5-2 win at the defending Stanley Cup champion Carolina Hurricanes on Friday, the Capitals found their footing in the second, answered with a goal and matched Tampa Bay with seven shots. Sourdif trimmed Washington's deficit in half at 7:04 after a turnover in the neutral zone. He raced toward the net and chipped in Jakob Chychrun's pass from the blue line for his first goal. The teams skated 4-on-4 early in the third after Tom Wilson and Zemgus Girgensons roughed each other behind Vasilevskiy, but the Lightning had a crucial penalty kill in the middle portion to help preserve the lead. With the net empty and just over two minutes remaining, Guentzel took a pass from Nikita Kucherov and iced the win. --Field Level Media

item.title: Leon Draisaitl's deciding goal lifts Oilers past Kraken
item.description: Leon Draisaitl scored the tiebreaking goal with 2:27 remaining to give the Edmonton Oilers a 3-1 victory against the visiting Seattle Kraken on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Leon Draisaitl scored the tiebreaking goal with 2:27 remaining to give the Edmonton Oilers a 3-1 victory against the visiting Seattle Kraken on Saturday. Connor McDavid added an empty-net goal with 1:05 left to clinch the victory. Owen Michaels also scored for the Oilers and goaltender Devon Levi made 19 saves as the Oilers won their second straight after a season-opening 6-5 overtime loss to visiting Vancouver. Bobby McMann tallied for the Kraken and Philipp Grubauer stopped 22 of 24 shots. The deciding goal came after McDavid sent a pass back to defenseman Ryan Shea at the left point. Shea, with his back to the net, banked the puck high off the boards to keep it in the offensive zone. The puck floated through the slot untouched until it reached Draisaitl outside the top right edge of the crease and he quickly put it past Grubauer. The Oilers took a 1-0 lead in the first period while outshooting the Kraken 10-5. Alex Formenton forced a turnover along the boards in the Seattle end and fed a backhanded pass to Michaels deep on the left wing. The rookie lifted a one-timer over Grubauer's shoulder and into the near upper corner of the net at 2:51. It was Michaels' second goal in as many games after also tallying in Thursday's 9-7 victory at Vancouver. Seattle tied it with a power-play goal in the second, when it had an 11-4 edge in shots. Jordan Eberle got the puck behind the Edmonton net and fed McMann in the lower inside corner of the left faceoff circle. McMann put a shot into the near upper corner of the net, beating Levi at 9:06. The Oilers, who led the NHL on the power play last season by converting 30.6% of their attempts, were held scoreless on three attempts with the man advantage by the Kraken, who were 31st of 32 teams last season on the penalty kill at 72.2%. Edmonton remained without four of its top seven forwards with Ryan Nugent-Hopkins (lower body), Jason Dickinson (undisclosed), Zach Hyman (undisclosed) and Matt Savoie (undisclosed) all injured. Forward Mackie Samoskevich made his Kraken debut after being activated off injured reserve (upper body) earlier in the day, with fellow forward Jacob Melanson going on the IR with an upper-body injury suffered in the season opener, a 6-1 victory Thursday at Calgary. --Field Level Media

item.title: USA/MIDTERMS-Trump tente de mobiliser les électeurs dans l'Ohio
item.description: Le président américain Donald Trump a adopté un ton combatif lors d'un rassemblement organisé samedi dans l'Ohio, l'un des Etats où le scrutin pour remporter un siège au Sénat lors des élections de mi-mandat pourrait être décisif.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le président américain Donald Trump a adopté un ton combatif lors d'un rassemblement organisé samedi dans l'Ohio, l'un des Etats où le scrutin pour remporter un siège au Sénat lors des élections de mi-mandat pourrait être décisif. "Allez simplement voter", a dit le président républicain lors d'un rassemblement en soutien aux candidats de son parti aux postes de sénateur, Jon Husted, et de gouverneur, Vivek Ramaswamy. "Si vous y allez, on va gagner, on va remporter une large victoire, et on va leur en faire voir de toutes les couleurs." De nombreux sénateurs républicains sortants à travers le pays sont confrontés à de rudes vents contraires sur le plan politique, alors que la popularité de Donald Trump a chuté ces derniers mois en raison de l'augmentation du coût de la vie et de la guerre en Iran. Les sondages suggèrent que les démocrates pourraient gagner du terrain lors des élections du 3 novembre, mais Donald Trump a affirmé que les républicains feraient mieux que ne le prévoient leurs détracteurs. "Je pense que nous allons leur réserver une grosse surprise, car ils ne savent pas ce qu'il se passe", a-t-il déclaré à la foule rassemblée à Vandalia, dans l'Ohio. Le sénateur républicain Jon Husted, nommé à ce siège en 2025 après la démission de J.D. Vance devenu vice-président, fait face à l'ancien sénateur démocrate Sherrod Brown, qui espère que les électeurs de l'Ohio se souviendront de son long parcours marqué par un populisme économique assumé alors qu'il tente de retrouver son siège. Donald Trump a recueilli plus de 55% des voix dans l'Ohio lors de l'élection présidentielle de 2024. L'Ohio fait partie des Etats où le [USN:L8N4500SK TEXT:"scrutin"] est considéré comme véritablement compétitifs pour remporter un siège au Sénat. Voir aussi: LE POINT sur les élections de mi-mandat du 3 novembre aux Etats-Unis ([USN:L8N4560J1 TEXT:"Full Story"])

item.title: Cornell president vows 'serious look' at fraternities, sororities in wake of rape allegations
item.description: A woman's lawsuit alleging that members of the Chi Phi fraternity drugged and raped her has sparked outrage and soul-searching over campus culture at the university.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cornell University will examine the role of fraternities and sororities on campus following an outcry over the school's handling of a student's rape allegations, the Ivy League school's president said on Saturday. A [USN:L1N45O0OO TEXT:"civil lawsuit"] filed last month by the woman, who alleges she was drugged and raped in 2024 by several members of the Chi Phi fraternity, has sparked [USN:L6N45O0CP TEXT:"outrage and soul-searching"] at Cornell over its campus culture at the school in Ithaca, New York. In a video message, Cornell University President Michael Kotlikoff said the school would take steps to prevent a similar situation in the future. That includes "a serious look at the role of fraternities and sororities in campus life," Kotlikoff said. "At their best, these organizations can provide students with friendship, belonging, mentorship and a powerful sense of community," he said. "But being part of a group can never diminish individual responsibility." The university will seek input, he said, from students, alumni and others on how to "preserve what is valuable about Greek life while strengthening individual accountability, transparency and a culture in which every member understands their responsibility to protect the safety and well-being of others." The lawsuit against Cornell, seven fraternity members and others, alleges that the school failed to adequately punish some of the accused students. The accused men have denied all wrongdoing, the New York Times reported. Cornell has defended its handling of the matter, saying it launched a comprehensive investigation and barred the Chi Phi fraternity from campus. The school said it imposed a range of disciplinary measures, including expulsions. But "we must do better," Kotlikoff said. "We don’t have all the answers, but we are committed to investigating and finding the answers our community deserves." He vowed that university officials would "be more transparent" about their actions related to the 2024 incident, but he did not detail specific initiatives that the university would take. "In the coming weeks, we will create additional opportunities for members of our community to ask questions and hear directly from university leadership," he said. The case has reignited scrutiny of how law enforcement and universities handle sexual assault complaints, with students questioning whether processes are enough to protect them. It has also drawn the attention of New York state officials, who have appointed a special prosecutor to investigate.

item.title: Jiri Kulich's third-period goal lifts Sabres past winless Blackhawks
item.description: After missing most of last season with a blood clot, Jiri Kulich scored the game-winning goal with 6:40 remaining in regulation to propel the Buffalo Sabres to a 4-3 victory in their home opener over the Chicago Blackhawks on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: After missing most of last season with a blood clot, Jiri Kulich scored the game-winning goal with 6:40 remaining in regulation to propel the Buffalo Sabres to a 4-3 victory in their home opener over the Chicago Blackhawks on Saturday. Tage Thompson tallied a goal and an assist, and Jack Quinn and Rasmus Dahlin also scored for the Sabres, while Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen made 12 saves in the victory. Ryan Donato, Tyler Bertuzzi and Oliver Moore scored for the Blackhawks. Anton Frondell and Alex Vlasic finished with two assists apiece, while Spencer Knight stopped 24 of the 28 shots he faced as Chicago opened its season with three straight losses. Donato started the scoring just under eight minutes into the game as he took a pass from Vlasic and fired a shot past Luukkonen to give the Blackhawks the early lead. Chicago doubled the lead with 8:36 left in the first period after Frondell slid a cross-crease pass to Bertuzzi, who tapped it into the open net. Quinn deked past a defender and then found Dahlin for a one-timer opportunity, but Knight kicked out the pad to deny the attempt with just over five minutes remaining in the first. Quinn got another chance minutes later as he burned past a defending player and unloaded a powerful wrist shot that found the back of the net with 16:24 gone in the period. Thompson knotted the game with his first goal of the young season as he tipped Louis Crevier's point shot past Knight with 14:19 left in the second. Frank Nazar went on a short-handed breakaway with just over three minutes remaining in the middle frame, but Luukkonen got just enough of Nazar's five-hole shot to force it wide of the net. Seconds after the penalty expired, Moore stepped out of the box, took a pass from Frondell and snuck it past Luukkonen to give the Blackhawks the 3-2 advantage with 18:18 expired in the period. Peyton Krebs led the counterattack into the Blackhawks' end and sent a pass to Dahlin, who quickly wired it past Knight to knot up the contest at three apiece with 13:50 left in the third period. Quinn looked to build upon his impressive night as he stormed toward the Blackhawks' net with 11:46 left, but Knight shut the door on the young speedster. Kulich notched his first goal of the season for the 4-3 edge on assists from Owen Power and Thompson. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ｆ１＝バーレーンＧＰ予選、フェルスタッペンが今季初ＰＰ
item.description: ［３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［３日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の第１６戦、バーレーン・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は３日、マレーシアのセパンで予選を行い、個人総合優勝４回を誇るマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ、レッドブル）が今季自身初のポールポジション（ＰＰ）を獲得した。

フェルスタッペンは１分３５秒１３０をマーク。２番手のルイス・ハミルトン（英国、フェラーリ）を０秒２９８上回った。フェルスタッペンの同僚、アイザック・ハジャー（フランス）が３番手に入ったが、パワーユニットのコンポーネント交換で、決勝では５グリッド降格のペナルティーを受ける。

総合首位のキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）は４番手でシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ、フェラーリ）が５番手。ランド・ノリス（英国）が６番手、オスカー・ピアストリ（オーストラリア）が７番手とマクラーレン勢が続き、総合２位のジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）は８番手に終わった。

中東情勢を受けて、今大会はマレーシアで開催されている。

item.title: Australia's Treasurer heads to Japan for inaugural finance ministerial forum
item.description: Australian Treasurer Jim Chalmers said he will travel to Japan on Sunday for talks with his Japanese counterpart in the first of an annual forum aiming to bolster bilateral ties.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australian Treasurer Jim Chalmers said he will travel to Japan on Sunday for talks with his Japanese counterpart in the first of an annual forum aiming to bolster bilateral ties. The main purpose of the inaugural Australia-Japan Finance Ministerial Dialogue would be to discuss "investment opportunities, strategic financing and international engagement more broadly", Chalmers said in a statement. He would seek to progress a deal with Japan's finance minister, Satsuki Katayama, to boost investment cooperation, the statement said. Japan was Australia's fourth-largest foreign investor in 2024, with total investments valued at A$282.9 billion ($196.7 billion), according to the government. The two countries face "many similar challenges as a result of global uncertainty, whether it’s higher energy prices driving up inflation or higher bond yields that are putting pressure on our budgets", the treasurer added. While in Japan, Chalmers said he would also meet more than 30 CEOs and business leaders to showcase Australia as a "premier investment destination". ($1 = 1.4382 Australian dollars)

item.title: イエメン軍、首都サヌアでフーシ派に空爆実施
item.description: [４日 ロイター] - イエメン軍は４日未明、首都サヌアと北西部サアダで、親イラン武装組織フーシ派
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[４日 ロイター] - イエメン軍は４日未明、首都サヌアと北西部サアダで、親イラン武装組織フーシ派 に対して攻撃を実施していると明らかにした

軍の報道官によると、同軍は「重要目標」と称する標的を攻撃したが、詳細には触れなかった。

フーシ派系のアルマシラＴＶはこれに先立ち、サウジアラビアによるサヌアへの攻撃があったと伝えた。サウジ側からの確認は直ちには得られていない。

イランが支援するフーシ派とサウジが支援する政府軍との紛争は、２０２２年の停戦後ほぼ沈静化していたが、イラン戦争の余波で戦闘が再燃している。

フーシ派は７月にサウジに対する海上封鎖を宣言し、サウジ領土や船舶への攻撃を開始。また、イエメンの紅海沿岸で大幅に勢力域を拡大した。サウジはイエメン政府軍を支援し、同国内のフーシ派拠点に空爆を実施している。

item.title: Drew Rasmussen dominates, Rays stifle Yankees to win ALDS opener
item.description: Drew Rasmussen did not allow a hit through 7 2/3 scoreless innings and Jonathan Aranda belted a solo homer, lifting the Tampa Bay Rays to a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees on Saturday in Game 1 of the American League Division Series in St. Petersburg, Fla.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Drew Rasmussen did not allow a hit through 7 2/3 scoreless innings and Jonathan Aranda belted a solo homer, lifting the Tampa Bay Rays to a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees on Saturday in Game 1 of the American League Division Series in St. Petersburg, Fla. "In all honesty, my heartbeat was about a thousand beats per minute, so I just let (catcher) Liam (Hicks) call the game and just try to execute the pitches he called," Rasmussen said on the TNT Sports broadcast. Austin Wells broke up Rasmussen's no-hit bid in the eighth with a blast down the right field line. However, he was thrown out in his attempt to stretch a double into a triple to end the inning. "Obviously not a good decision there," Yankees manager Aaron Boone said. "Not sure if he saw something on his way between first and second that caused him to go there, but obviously a mistake there." Wells said after he passed second base, he saw third base coach Luis Rojas with his hands up for him to stop there, but he already was committed to run to third. "(They) made two good throws and it got me," Wells said. "Thought it kicked off more than it did, (right fielder Victor Mesa Jr.) made a good play on the ball. Two outs there, trying to make something happen, be aggressive with not much going on in the game. Obviously, love to safe there or standing on second base." That was the lone hit allowed by Rasmussen (1-0), who struck out 10 batters in eight innings. Right-hander Bryan Baker struck out two batters in a 1-2-3 ninth inning to secure his first career postseason save. Aranda belted a solo homer in the third inning as one of the five hits for the Rays, who secured a 1-0 lead in the best-of-five series. Game 2 is Monday in St. Petersburg. Aranda deposited a 2-2 changeup from right-hander Gerrit Cole (0-1) over the wall in right-center field to account for the scoring in the third inning. The Yankees' bats went silent after outscoring the rival Boston Red Sox by an 18-2 margin and out-hitting them 26-7 during a two-game sweep in the wild-card round. Captain Aaron Judge was left off New York's roster for the ALDS. Judge, 34, has not played since Sept. 16 due to a strained right calf. The three-time AL MVP landed on the injured list three days later and missed the Yankees' wild-card sweep earlier this week. Rasmussen also dominated the Yankees in three of four meetings during the regular season, including a one-run, one-hit, 11-strikeout performance over 6 2/3 innings of a 6-1 romp on Sept. 22. The Rays clinched the AL East title with that victory. "At that point, we had the opportunity to win the division. Obviously, this one is a postseason game. Both meaningful, both impactful," Rasmussen told reporters about his last two outings against New York. Rasmussen allowed only a pair of walks, one each in the second and third innings, and retired the final 16 batters he faced on Saturday. "It seemed like he went and doubled down tonight," Rays manager Kevin Cash said, noting Rasmussen's previous start against the Yankees. "Made it easy to sit back and just take some decisions out of our hands." Rasmussen also showed his defensive chops by getting off the mound to field a bunt and throw out Ryan McMahon to begin the sixth inning. He finished that inning unscathed, marking the deepest no-hit bid in franchise history and the deepest into a postseason game the Yankees have ever been no-hit. Cole permitted one run on five hits in five innings. "Biggest issue is Rasmussen shutting us down," Boone said. "Obviously, we had a handful of guys hit some balls on the screws - Austin (Wells) being one of them a couple times there -- we just didn't generate enough, obviously." --Field Level Media

item.title: Poor start for Red Wings can be turned around against Jets
item.description: The Detroit Red Wings' season opener couldn't have gone much worse. They'll look for a better result and more fan support when they host the Winnipeg Jets on Sunday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Detroit Red Wings' season opener couldn't have gone much worse. They'll look for a better result and more fan support when they host the Winnipeg Jets on Sunday afternoon. Detroit endured a tumultuous offseason in which former captain Dylan Larkin requested a trade and former top executive and franchise legend Steve Yzerman was reassigned to an advisory role. Team owner Chris Ilitch still hasn't hired a permanent replacement for Yzerman, as in-house candidate Shawn Horcoff was named interim general manager prior to training camp. Restricted free agent Simon Edvinsson, one of the team's top defensemen, remains unsigned and returned to his native Sweden earlier in the week as negotiations stalled. Larkin remains on the roster but missed Friday's opener against the New York Rangers with an upper-body injury and won't play on Sunday. He was heavily booed during pregame introductions and chants of "Sell the team," directed at Ilitch, cascaded from the stands at times during Detroit's 2-0 loss. "Obviously he has to live with the ramifications of asking for a trade," coach Todd McLellan said of Larkin. "It's not comfortable for anybody and I feel bad for him, I do." The rest of the players also had to deal with the vitriol from disenchanted fans. "Everyone has a right to express their feelings and we just have to deal with it," defenseman Moritz Seider said after Friday's loss. "We handled it pretty well. Everyone gave it their best shot, and that's what we'll continue to do. You should be professional enough. We get paid to do our job. We have a great opportunity in front of us, to get back to work (Saturday) and prepare ourselves for hopefully our first win in two days." The Red Wings' defense played well without Edvinsson but the offense was punchless without Larkin. "We're going to have to score goals to win games," McLellan said. "The players that we have here, they have to understand and expect it from themselves and their teammates. You just can't rely on three or four guys." The Jets opened their season on Friday with a 4-3 overtime loss to Boston. Winnipeg failed to protect a late 3-2 lead. "I like a lot of what we did. There's mistakes, but we came out strong," said Kyle Connor, who extended his NHL record by scoring in a ninth straight season opener. "We had a little bit of a dip there, and obviously they got one to tie it up. But overall, I thought we played pretty quick." The Jets have a major controversy of their own involving one of their top players. Star goaltender Connor Hellebuyck wants to be traded and didn't report to camp, prompting a suspension. Hellebuyck, like Larkin, is a Michigan native. Stuart Skinner was the starting goaltender on Friday, making 26 saves. Skinner was signed to a two-year deal in July. "I think we were ready. You saw us in the first ten minutes. I think the shots were like eight to one. We were ready to rock and roll. That's just kind of how the game works. There's ebbs and flows of the game," Skinner said. "You know, Boston's definitely going to have their push. We knew that was going to happen. But all in all, I thought we did a really good job and just got to tighten up a few things." --Field Level Media

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝ヤンキース主将ジャッジ、地区シリーズはロースター外
item.description: ［３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［３日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）ヤンキースが３日、レイズとの地区シリーズ（５回戦制）の２６人のロースターを発表。主将アーロン・ジャッジ外野手（３４）はメンバーを外れた。

ジャッジは右ふくらはぎの肉離れの影響で９月１６日以降プレーしておらず、その３日後に負傷者リスト（ＩＬ）入り。通算３回のア・リーグＭＶＰ（最優秀選手）選出を誇る同選手は、レッドソックスとのワイルドカードシリーズも欠場した。ヤンキースは同シリーズで２連勝し、地区シリーズに勝ち上がった。

ヤンキースのアーロン・ブーン監督は、ジャッジをロースターに入れなかったことについて「最終的にそれが最善と判断した」とコメント。「彼が復帰に近付いているように感じている」としながらも、「アーロンが本来の状態で復帰し、われわれがワールドシリーズで優勝するためには、あと１週間、彼が復帰に向けて努力を続けることが重要だ」と話した。

さらに同監督は「彼はランニングを始めたばかりで、打撃練習は数日前に再開した。これをさらに数日続けて、持久力を身に付けることが大事」とも述べた。

ジャッジは肋骨の骨折で３カ月以上離脱。９月８日に復帰した後、７試合に出場したが、打率１割７分４厘、１本塁打、３打点とふるわなかった。レギュラーシーズンでは６６試合に出場し、打率２割４分１厘、１８本塁打、４１打点だった。

item.title: サッカー＝欧州ＮＬ、イングランド7得点で大勝 スペイン3連勝
item.description: ［３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［３日　ロイター］ - サッカーの欧州ネーションズリーグ（ＮＬ）は３日、各地で１次リーグの試合を行い、リーグＡの３組ではイングランドが主将のハリー・ケーンらのゴールでクロアチアに７─０と大勝した。

イングランドは前半８分、ジュード・ベリンガムのパスを受けたケーンが守備陣２枚の間を抜けて先制ゴール。同２１分にベリンガムが決めて加点すると、３─０として迎えた同４５分にベリンガムのクロスからブカヨ・サカがネットを揺らした。

イングランドは後半もケーンとサカのゴールでリードを広げると、同４２分にベリンガムのお膳立てからモーガン・ロジャースにも得点が生まれた。ベリンガムは１試合１ゴール３アシスト。代表通算ゴール数を８９としたケーンは、これが１２４試合目。ピーター・シルトン氏の同代表最多出場記録まであと１試合となった。

同組のスペインはチェコを３─１で破り、開幕から３戦全勝とした。前半６分にラミン・ヤマルがペナルティーエリアの端から左足で強烈なシュートを放つと、同３５分には代表で２年以上ゴールのなかったロドリが決めて２点を先行。後半に１点を失ったが、最後はミケル・メリノのゴールで突き放した。

これにより、同組ではスペインが勝ち点９で首位、イングランドは同６で２位としている。

リーグＢの１組ではスイスがスロベニアを２─１で下して３戦全勝で首位をキープ。スコットランドは北マケドニアを２─０で破り、スロベニアと同じ勝ち点４とした。

item.title: アジア大会＝日本選手団、金メダル83個で60年ぶりに最多更新
item.description: ［３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［３日　ロイター］　 - 愛知・名古屋アジア大会では３日、日本選手団の金メダル数が８３個に到達。これまでの記録を上回り、最多となった。１９６６年バンコク大会で記録した７８を６０年ぶりに更新した。

日本はソフトボール決勝では中国に７─０で快勝し、７連覇を達成。柔道混合団体ではカザフスタンを４─０で下し、３連覇を果たした。ラグビー７人制女子決勝では中国に１０─５で勝利し、８年ぶりの金メダル。水球男子でも優勝した。

セパタクロー男子クワッド（４人制）では日本初の金メダルに輝き、ブレイキン男子では半井重幸（ダンサー名・SHIGEKIX）が２連覇を達成。初採用のパデル、女子ダブルスは塚本早紀、徳本佳恵組が制した。
